questions.q: What were the Thessalonians enduring, according to Paul?
How will the Lord Jesus be revealed from heaven?
options: With his mighty angels in flaming fire
Riding on the clouds with thunder
With a great trumpet and a shout
Surrounded by the saints in glory

questions.q: What penalty does Paul describe for those who don't obey the Good News?
options: Eternal destruction from the face of the Lord

questions.q: Who will be punished when the Lord Jesus is revealed?
options: Those who don't know God or obey the Good News
Those who worship idols in the temple

questions.q: It is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction ____.
wrong: to the rulers of this age

questions.q: That you may be counted worthy of ____, for which you also suffer.
That our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and ____ with power.

items: Thanks for their growing faith and love
Relief for the afflicted when Jesus is revealed
Prayer that God counts them worthy

questions.q: Paul says the Thessalonians' faith has weakened under persecution.
Paul says his testimony to the Thessalonians was believed.
What does Paul say abounds in each of them toward one another?
Where does Paul boast about the Thessalonians?
When the Lord comes in that day, in whom will he be glorified?
How often does Paul say he prays for them?
options: On the first day of the week

questions.q: That the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and ____.
We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as ____.
Silvanus and Timothy are named with Paul at the start of this letter.
What false claim was troubling the Thessalonians?
options: The day of Christ had already come

questions.q: What does Paul say must come before that day?
options: The rebellion and the man of sin revealed
A great famine across the earth
The gospel preached to every nation

questions.q: Where does the man of sin sit, setting himself up as God?
How will the Lord kill the lawless one?
options: With the breath of his mouth
By the hand of an archangel

questions.q: Stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether ____.
Because they didn't receive ____, that they might be saved.
Because of this, God sends them ____, that they should believe a lie.

items: The mystery of lawlessness already works
The lawless one revealed and destroyed
Prayer for comfort and every good work

questions.q: Paul says he never spoke of these things while he was with them.
Paul says the lawless one comes by the working of Satan, with signs and lying wonders.
For what does Paul say God chose them from the beginning?
What other title does Paul give the lawless one?
Through what did God call them?
Against what does the lawless one exalt himself?
options: All that is called God or worshiped

questions.q: Who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and ____ through grace.
That they all might be judged who didn't believe the truth, but ____.
Paul warns them not to be troubled by a letter claiming to be from him.
What does Paul first ask them to pray for?
options: That the word of the Lord spreads rapidly
That he be released from prison
That he may visit them soon

questions.q: What were some among them doing instead of working?
What does Paul say about the greeting at the end of his letters?
options: He writes it with his own hand
He seals it with a ring

questions.q: How should they treat a man who doesn't obey the letter?
options: Admonish him as a brother, not an enemy
Hand him over to the elders
Report him to the other churches

questions.q: If anyone is not willing to work, ____.
But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and ____.
questions.answer: guard you from the evil one

questions.q: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and into ____.

items: Pray for deliverance from evil men
Withdraw from those walking in rebellion
Work with quietness and eat your own bread
Note the disobedient and keep no company

questions.q: Paul says he ate bread from others without paying for it while he was with them.
Paul says that not all people have faith.
What does Paul tell the brothers not to be weary in?
What does Paul ask the Lord of peace to give them?
options: Peace at all times in all ways

questions.q: Why did Paul work for his food instead of using his right to support?
options: To be an example for them to imitate

questions.q: Paul asks that the word of the Lord be glorified even as it was where?
Withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after ____ from us.
Note that man and have no company with him, to the end that ____.
Paul admits that he behaved rebelliously while he was among them.
